summary.id: Temukan tema iman, ibadah, akhlak, kisah, dan tanggung jawab sosial tanpa melepas konteks.
summary.en: Explore themes of faith, worship, character, narratives, and social responsibility without losing context.

text.id: Pendekatan tematik mengumpulkan pelajaran terkait sambil memperhatikan konteks dan penjelasan ulama.
text.en: A thematic approach gathers related lessons while respecting context and scholarly explanation.

text.id: Pelajar menandai bacaan tentang kesabaran lalu membandingkan konteksnya sebelum merangkum.
text.en: A learner bookmarks readings about patience and compares their contexts before summarizing.

body.id: Pilih satu tema, simpan dua bacaan terkait, dan catat satu tindakan yang sesuai.
body.en: Choose one theme, save two related readings, and note one suitable action.
